force_reference: max(max physical N19 ||P|| * h^2, max physical N19 ||b|| * h^3); common N19 scale for N27
recovery_F_metric: Fbar(x_solved)-Fbar(x_target), normalized by 0.004; separately report Fbar(x_solved)-F_local(X), including target reconstruction bias
recovery_reason: For nonaffine fields truncated shape reconstruction is not analytically exact even at the prescribed nodal solution; solver recovery compares the same discrete observable at both states.
solver_force_floor: F_ref; adapter scale is max(L2 external free-node load, F_ref)
perturbation: 0.02*epsilon*L*prod(sin(pi*(X-lower)/L))*[1,-0.4,0.7]; both z faces fixed to uL
N27_field: Same physical polynomial with fixed L=1.125 mm; specimen extent alone becomes 26h
bulk_difference_rule: SMALL if max norm(e_model)/max norm(b_local) <= 0.001, MATERIAL above; INCONCLUSIVE if oracle not validated. Descriptive 0.1% body-force scale threshold, not universality claim.
global_accounting: BC - surface = model - (nodal body - continuum body) - internal resultant; retain every term
sign_convention: Section 11: fBC=bulkTarget-fFD. Section 20 reverses the verbal order; use section 11 consistently.
optional_shear: NOT_RUN: complete required axial localization and two equilibrium controls only
